name: workflow-gate-terminal
description: workflow-gate in the terminal: see the plan, change model tiers, approve, watch the run live. Records approvals through the installed workflow-gate plugin.

teamHistory.title: Team history
teamHistory.description: read pulls the team's lessons on designing workflows (structure, model tiers, missions, verification, cost) into every plan review; share also pushes the lessons your retros draw — never about your project: retros, step verdicts, the bandit and rewritten missions stay on your machine; off does neither.

teamHistoryRemote.title: Team history repo
teamHistoryRemote.description: Git remote holding the shared learnings. Empty by default: with no remote, team history stays off whatever you choose above.

teamHistoryBranch.title: Team history branch
teamHistoryBranch.description: Branch of that repo, one JSON file of workflow-design lessons per run under each author's folder.
